title: Travis Kelce: Marrying Taylor Swift ‘Was More Than I Could Have Ever Dreamed It to Be’
summary: The athlete opened up about his nuptials just days before the Kansas City Chiefs return for another NFL season.
contentText:
Travis Kelce is still buzzing about his and Taylor Swift ‘s wedding day, two months later.

Related

Travis Kelce Gushes His ‘Perfect’ Wedding to Taylor Swift ‘Was the Best Night’ of His Life in First Remarks

Travis Kelce Shares Taylor Swift’s Reaction to Publicly Debuting Their Dog After Keeping Her ‘Under Wraps’ for a Year

Here’s Everything We Know About Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding

In an upcoming interview with ESPN’s Chris Berman alongside teammate Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs tight end gushed about his recent nuptials in a teaser clip that ESPN aired Friday (Sept. 11). “It was the best night of my life,” Kelce began.

“Marrying Taylor was, you know, it was more than I could have ever dreamed it to be because of all the people that showed up,” he continued, “and the amount of, you know, love that was in the air.”

“Glad you said ‘Taylor,’ because I couldn’t come up with a name,” joked Berman.

The Ohio native and pop star tied the knot over Fourth of July weekend in New York City, hosting a massive celebration at Madison Square Garden with a reported 1,000 people in attendance. Adam Sandler officiated the ceremony, while Paul McCartney and Stevie Nicks performed for a star-studded guest list — Mahomes included.

“My perspective, it was a lot of fun,” the quarterback said during the ESPN interview, which is set to air Sept. 14 before the Chiefs kick off against the Denver Broncos in their first game of the 2026-27 season. “I did a little dancing. I didn’t know if I was gonna be able to dance, and it was good to get my first dancing experience of the offseason.”

The Chiefs teased the interview a few days prior on X , captioning a photo of the three men on the set of the interview with “(Not so) patiently waiting for Monday night ⏰ @PatrickMahomes x @tkelce x @ESPNNFL.”

Kelce also recently opened up about his big day on the season premiere of New Heights . “Me and Taylor are so thankful to everybody that showed up,” he said on the episode. “It was just so magical, man. Thank you to everyone at MSG that allowed us to do this. We wanted to do it somewhere where we could have a very intimate and genuine setting without a lot of distractions, we needed it to be a private feel.”

The Grotesquerie actor also confirmed his dog dad status after debuting his and Swift’s Samoyed, Wendy, in a new Tommy Hilfiger campaign. “She’s a model dog,” Kelce said proudly at the time. “Little Wendy’s a little over a year old now — we’ve had her for quite a while. Tried to keep it under wraps, but got sniped at the airport.”
